business_summary: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Lt provides solutions for urban development and city operations in China and internationally. The company offers consulting; urban renewal; one-stop headquarters technology park construction; ecosystem planning; smart construction platform; green sustainable development; lifecycle management; and city information modeling platform integration. It also provides smart wellness and elderly care, such as smart living environment design and renovation services, which include smart home systems, barrier-free designs, and safety monitoring systems; health monitoring and management systems consisting of health monitoring devices and health management platforms; personalized care, such as customized living solutions and professional nursing services; and smart elderly care community development, including smart elderly care center, community activity organization, research and development innovation, and product sale and rental. In addition, the company offers real estate models for high-end residences, affordable housing, cultural and artistic real estate, commercial office real estate, sports-related real estate, luxury hotels and mixed-use developments, green buildings and senior living communities, smart exhibition centers, co-living communities and talent housing, modular interior space, educational real estate, medical facilities, and tourism real estate, as well as architectural planning, interior design, renovation, soft furnishings, furniture, and landscaping services for luxury villas. Further, it engages in stone processing and sales; architectural design, decoration, and construction; cabinet production and installation; curtain wall engineering; sale of building materials; technology development; building technology; IoT; investment management; technology promotion and application; business; and general instrument manufacturing. Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd는 중국 및 국제적으로 도시 개발 및 도시 운영을 위한 솔루션을 제공합니다. 회사는 컨설팅을 제공합니다. 도시재생; 원스톱 본사 기술파크 건설; 생태계 계획; 스마트 건설 플랫폼; 녹색 지속 가능한 개발; 수명주기 관리; 및 도시 정보 모델링 플랫폼 통합. 또한 스마트 홈 시스템, 무장애 설계, 안전 모니터링 시스템을 포함한 스마트 생활 환경 설계 및 혁신 서비스와 같은 스마트 웰니스 및 노인 간호를 제공합니다. 건강 모니터링 장치와 건강 관리 플랫폼으로 구성된 건강 모니터링 및 관리 시스템; 맞춤형 생활 솔루션, 전문 간호 서비스 등 맞춤형 케어; 스마트 노인 돌봄 센터, 지역 사회 활동 조직, 연구 개발 혁신, 제품 판매 및 임대를 포함한 스마트 노인 돌봄 커뮤니티 개발. 또한, 고급 주택, 저렴한 주택, 문화 예술 부동산, 상업용 사무실 부동산, 스포츠 관련 부동산, 고급 호텔 및 복합 개발업자를 위한 부동산 모델을 제공하고 있습니다.
